metas.name: 1 · ★ 6.6 · 1979 · Phantasm
metas.description: Newly orphaned teenager Mike Pearson, his older brother Jody, and their friends face off against a mysterious grave robber known as the Tall Man, who employs a lethal arsenal of unearthly weapons in their southern California town.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 6.4 · 1988 · Phantasm II
metas.description: Mike, now released from a psychiatric hospital, meets with Reggie, and discover his dreams (the events of the original film) are real, and they both journey to find and stop the evil Tall Man from his grim work.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 6.0 · 1994 · Phantasm III: Lord of the Dead
metas.description: Mike and Reggie continue to hunt the mysterious Tall Man, discovering along the way that the invasion has already begun.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 5.5 · 1998 · Phantasm IV: Oblivion
metas.description: Mike travels through time and dimensions to find the Tall Man's origins.

metas.name: 5 · ★ 4.9 · 2016 · Phantasm: Ravager
metas.description: The final installment of the long-running Phantasm series.
